name: Sampler
author: tango
summary: One of everything an extension can add: a patch, a drawn view, a shader view and a component. A place to start your own.

patches.name: Format Number
patches.summary: Writes a number as text, with a fixed number of decimals, separators for thousands, and text before and after.

views.name: Progress Ring
views.summary: A ring that fills clockwise from the top as its progress goes from 0 to 1.

views.name: Stripes
views.summary: Diagonal stripes in two colors. Added as an ordinary shader view whose code you can change.
